content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe and PayPal block 90% of creators from collecting payments. Conventional platforms fail where currency controls tighten. This guide deploys your digital store on Cloudflare Pages—free, sovereign, and immune to platform rejection. You’ll own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. Your store processes crypto payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and operates without depending on any third party. [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-9|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/how-start-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-honest-side-side-6|Selling Ebooks]]-digital-products-crypto-honest-side-2|start]] with Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments) or upgrade to Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments) for enterprise-grade scaling. This is not a workaround. It’s base-layer commerce infrastructure.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages are globally distributed, immune to regional restrictions. They serve static sites with 0ms cold starts. Cloudflare Workers execute backend logic at the edge, closer to your buyers. Supabase manages orders with PostgreSQL reliability. NOWPayments verifies on-chain crypto payments without KYC. Together, these tools bypass payment processors, currency controls, and platform fees. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No single point of failure. No platform can shut you down. This stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm, not the exception.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a digital product, a crypto wallet, and the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). The blueprint provides step-by-step documentation and source code. The Edge Stack deploys Stack 02 in 48 hours, end-to-end tested. For Stack 01, allocate 4-6 hours to follow the blueprint. For Stack 02, COREMERCH handles deployment. Both stacks require a NOWPayments API key (free, no KYC). Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. Your wallet holds payments directly—no intermediaries. Your store URL becomes your brand’s fortress. No platform can revoke it.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy backend logic first. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle payment verification and product delivery. Configure NOWPayments to fire a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Host product files on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Test the pipeline with testnet transactions before going live. Stack 01 uses Apps Script for simplicity. Stack 02 uses Workers for serverless scaling. Both stacks integrate NOWPayments’ 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. The pipeline is stateless—no server costs, no maintenance. Payments hit your wallet instantly. Products deliver automatically. The system runs itself.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own—no platform can shut it down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Point your custom domain or use the default URL. Test the full flow: payment, verification, delivery. Use mainnet transactions to confirm end-to-end functionality. Stack 02 includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. Promote your store URL (example: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html) to your audience. Monitor transactions in your wallet and order database. The first sale proves the infrastructure works. Every subsequent sale reinforces your sovereignty. No platform takes a cut. No buyer needs an account. Your store operates on your terms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Add products by uploading files and updating your database. Clone the pipeline for new offerings. Stack 02’s Supabase handles millions of orders. Cloudflare Workers scale to billions of requests monthly. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for 5 pre-loaded products and 30-day support. The Scaling Playbook in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) documents advanced strategies. Your infrastructure grows with your business. No platform limits. No feature walls. You own the stack—expand it as needed. This is not renting. This is building.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. It’s deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. COREMERCH deploys it in 48 hours, end-to-end tested. Stack 01 is simpler, ideal for starters. Stack 02 is enterprise-grade, with email configuration and 5 pre-loaded products. Both stacks give you full ownership and sovereignty. Choose Stack 01 to build yourself. Choose Stack 02 to deploy faster with expert configuration.
Crypto payments hit your wallet directly—no intermediaries, no fees beyond 0.5%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Stack 01 is your entry point to sovereign commerce. For creators ready to scale, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Stack 02 in 48 hours—Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. It includes 5 pre-loaded products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and 30-day support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to see a live example. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant download. Whether you build or deploy, your infrastructure remains sovereign. No platform owns your store. You do.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 2. Set up a crypto wallet on BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 3. Create a NOWPayments account and generate an API key. 4. Deploy backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure NOWPayments webhooks to trigger product delivery. 6. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 7. Upload product files to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 8. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 9. Test the full flow with testnet transactions. 10. Promote your store URL to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use my own domain with Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages?
Yes. Both platforms support custom domains. Cloudflare Pages offers free SSL. GitHub Pages requires configuring DNS records. Your store URL becomes your brand’s fortress—no platform can revoke it.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?
Refunds are manual. Send the exact amount back to the buyer’s wallet address. Document refund policies clearly. Crypto payments are irreversible, so verify buyer details before processing.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your store remains operational. NOWPayments’ webhook is the only dependency. If it fails, payments still hit your wallet. Reconfigure the webhook or switch to a backup payment processor.
Can I sell physical products with this infrastructure?

No. This stack is designed for digital products—ebooks, courses, templates, etc. Physical products require shipping integration, which is not included. Focus on digital offerings for automatic delivery.
How do I secure my store against DDoS attacks?
Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages include DDoS protection by default. Cloudflare Workers add edge-level security. For additional protection, enable Cloudflare’s WAF (Web Application Firewall) rules.
